source_contracts: Native public Manifest/Entry/Artifact and catalogue::compile expose required data; private Registry/Verified fields are never read or forged. Actual native Registry::load derives IDs.

Distinct Transfer setup calls unchanged pari::setup(compiledTransferRelation,SysRng,Sequential) only once, no metadata-only key mutation. Original complete all7 registry is validated first, all14 artifacts checksummed with65536-byte streaming chunks before and after. Six other PK/VK artifacts copied exactly.

Before and after fresh publication native Registry::load checks full keys.v2 closed family set, all VKs, current exact relations and domain sizes. First real witness_auth_build under both registries exercises lazy PK checksum/decode/embedded-VK, not only loader success.

One completed actual Transfer plan is built under both valid registries. Both own proofs verify positively, statements and relation match exactly, native Transfer VKs and registry IDs differ. Cross-key individual/batch failures must be invalid Pari proof/batch, not family/relation/decoder failures.

Original genuinely minted capability under alternate Registry fails proof capability registry mismatch; original verified transaction under alternate App fails verified transaction registry mismatch with complete snapshot equality. Same raw cache entry does not hit alternate native registry ID; alternate genuine delivery then passes.

Queue control verifies2 distinct real Transfer items, accepts exact artifact/family queue order, then reverses only genuine capabilities and requires verified proof capability mismatch. No mutated proof or fabricated Verified is introduced.

Effect/auth control verifies original genuine body+fee proof/signature pipeline, mutates transaction parameters without reauthorizing and separately moves exact body/fee Transfer values between locations. Exact native hash changes, binding/action signature errors and location context errors must be observed. This covers body/fee ordering, not arbitrary multi-body permutation.

Cryptographic assumptions, trusted correctly generated setup, full row-to-native Transfer semantics, Rust-to-Lean refinement and arbitrary store crash durability remain OPEN. Offline source tests, identities and recipes are not runtime controls.
execution_requirements: No active or frozen runtime stage may change. Stage in a fresh successor over the six-control child after exact parent source inventories/pass, then append the reviewed snippet and add the diagnostic example only. Retain full parent before/after and child after; validate exact3 resources and exact2 runtime path deltas.

Complete original setup05 registry is UNRUN; all7/15 files, relation/domain/native source/setup executable/source inventory and resource receipts must pass before distinct setup. Preserve all old/failed partial03 and v1 registries.

Build/setup/control jobs are root-only after serial capture/kernel work. Same direct validated PSAPI host sampling/admission3GiB physical/1.5GiB commit and reserves1.5GiB/512MiB, task-only finite cgroup/process group/swap, one Cargo/test thread; never weaken guards.

Native setup may have large compiled relation/key/encoding allocations. Use existing guarded setup policy at least768MiB resident/8GiB task swap/7200s+200 finite cap or root-approved measured successor; no setup job is provided or launched here.

Build example under --locked --offline --profile ci -p shieldd-sdk-proof-params --example transfer_distinct_registry -j1 with exact circuits opt-level0 and retained native source inventory. Call only with exact complete registry05 and fresh distinct destination. Existing destination/staging are refused; failed owned partial staging retained.

Each named test is exact --lib -- --exact --test-threads=1 --nocapture under correctly generated SHIELDD_PARI_KEYS registry05. Distinct key test also requires SHIELDD_TRANSFER_DISTINCT_KEYS pointing only to the complete distinct native registry. Actual one test passed, intended labelled semantic failures and positive readbacks required.
Compilation, missing key/parent, loader/prover/fixture failure, timeout, OOM, zero tests or any other rejection cause is infrastructure failure, not successful control.
